scripts.gen:setup-sql: (echo "-- BioPrep: complete database setup in one file. Paste into Supabase > SQL Editor and click Run, ONCE, on a fresh project."; echo "-- This is every file in supabase/migrations, in order. Generated by: npm run gen:setup-sql"; for f in $(ls supabase/migrations/*.sql | sort); do echo; echo "-- ===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; done) > supabase/setup-all.sql
